test_list.description: POLARIS_ISSUES_FILE value beats an explicit path and the default.
An explicit path beats the workspace default.
The default is <root>/.polaris/issues.md with root found by .git from a nested start directory.
A .polaris directory also marks the workspace root.
Without markers the start directory is the root.
A root ISSUES.md is moved into place once and the move is reported.
An existing ledger is never overwritten by migration.
Loading a ledger that does not exist gives an empty ledger.
